summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks how a weakened king should act; Bhishma explains that in crises rulers may use harsh means to restore power while preserving life and future stability.

image_candidates.scene_text: The god Yama appears before the ascetic Gotama performing severe penance in a lonely hermitage on the Paripatra hills.
Yudhishthira sits before the aged Bhishma on the battlefield bed of arrows, asking how a ruined king should survive among enemies.
